snippet.title: 5 MORE Claude Code MODS You Need | Get Ahead of 95% in 9 Minutes
snippet.description:
🚨 UPDATE ON AUTO MODEL 🚨: A few of you made a great point in the comments. Claude’s cache is tied to the model, so when Auto Model switches models in the middle of a long session, the new model has to reread your whole conversation, and switching back and forth can end up costing more than it saves. Auto Model really should only pick the model at the start of a session.  So if you're building it yourself, please keep that in mind and I’ve put the Auto Model prompt on hold. Thanks for catching it! 

👇 FREE: Get the prompts for all 5 Claude mods in this video, plus my full Prompt Library and AI newsletter: https://tristenobrien.ai

🎬 All my animations were done with Claude Code, Remotion, and  Higgsfield: https://higgsfield.ai?fpr=tristen15

📚 Buy my book, The Smartest Move 👉 https://tristenobrien.ai/smartest-move/
_____

Claude Mods are one of the biggest updates Claude Code has ever given us, and I can't stop building them. In my last video I showed you five Claude Code mods. Here are five more, and I think these are even better.

In this video you'll see a mod that automatically picks the right Claude model for every prompt (Haiku 5.5 for quick questions, Opus 5.5 for big builds), a mod that turns a one-line prompt into a detailed one by asking you a few questions first, a report that shows how many hours and dollars Claude saved you, a retro TV that plays YouTube right inside Claude Code while you wait, and a daily challenge that helps you get better at Claude every single day.

I built every one of these just by describing what I wanted to Claude. No coding required.
_____

⏱️ CHAPTERS

0:00 5 More Claude Mods
0:29 What Is a Claude Mod?
1:10 Where My Mods Live
1:22 Mod 1: Auto Model
2:58 Mod 2: Prompt Upgrade
4:15 Mod 3: Today's Report
6:08 Mod 4: YouTube TV
7:13 Mod 5: Daily Challenge
8:29 Recap and Free Prompts
_____

THE 5 MODS IN THIS VIDEO

1. Auto Model. Reads your prompt and switches to the right Claude model on its own, so you're not burning through your plan on questions a smaller model can answer.

2. Prompt Upgrade. Asks you a few quick questions, then rewrites your short prompt into a much more detailed one you can edit, copy or run with one click.

3. Today's Report. Shows how many tasks Claude did for you, the hours it saved you, and what that time is worth, by day, week, month and year.

4. YouTube TV. An old-school TV that plays YouTube right inside Claude Code while Claude works on a big job.

5. Daily Challenge. One small Claude challenge every day, with a "Coach me through it" button and a streak to keep you coming back.

Grab the free prompts for all five: https://tristenobrien.ai
_____

WHAT YOU NEED

Claude Mods work in the Claude Code terminal and in the Code tab of the Claude desktop app on Mac and Windows. You need Claude Code version 2.1.287 or newer and a paid Claude plan that includes Claude Code. Only install mods from people you trust, because a mod has the same access to your computer that Claude Code does.
_____

▶️ WATCH NEXT: Claude Code Just Dropped MODS (Master it in 10 Minutes): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LDn7rQKIFro
